source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: A TRANSPORT can carry other units around the battlefield. This chapter explains [Transport Capacity](vsdata:core-rule/transport-capacity), [Embarking](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) and [Disembarking](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking). Leaving the TRANSPORT uses the [Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/disembark-move) or [Emergency Disembark Move](vsdata:core-rule/emergency-disembark-move). [Rapid Disembark And Limitations](vsdata:core-rule/rapid-disembark-and-limitations) explains when Ingress restrictions carry over to passengers.
